key_icons: A flat silver keypad on the slide in four rows with dark labels, separated by thin lines, each digit with its small letters to its right. The 1 key shows a small voicemail symbol (two small rings joined along their bottoms); the 5 key has a small dot above it; the * key also shows '+'; the 0 key also shows a space symbol; the # key also shows a/A and a small silent (crossed note) symbol.
